Guidance & outlook: Net Proﬁt after Tax: The net proﬁt after tax, excluding comprehensive income, stood at ₹2,470.04 Lakhs for FY 2025-26 as against ₹2,520.50 Lakhs for FY 2024-25, reﬂecting a decrease of approximately 2.00%.
Diluted earnings per share stood at ₹4.85 in FY 2025-26 as against ₹4.95 in FY 2024-25.
Return on Net Worth decreased from 24.29% in FY 2024-25 to 20.02% in FY 2025-26.
Growth & demand: The Company recorded Total Income of ₹ 9,222.63 Lakhs as against ₹7,143.58 Lakhs in the previous year, reﬂecting healthy growth in business performance.

The Board has recommended a dividend of ₹ 0.50 per Equity Share for the ﬁnancial year, reﬂecting its commitment to rewarding shareholders while maintaining adequate resources to support future growth.
Cost eﬃciency programs together with strategic investments for new facilities, product launches, and launch of online business models supported this journey of proﬁtable growth.
Margins & costs: Rising employee costs, technology investments, digital infrastructure expenditure, content development costs, marketing expenses and competitive pricing pressures may also impact operating margins and proﬁtability.
EBITDA EBITDA for the full year was reported at ₹3,714.42 Lakhs as against ₹3,719.31 Lakhs in the previous year, showing a marginal decrease of approximately 0.13%.
Operating proﬁt margin: The operating proﬁt margin decreased from 49.91% in FY 2024-25 to 37.23% in FY 2025-26.
Capex & expansion: The Budget highlights include measures such as a Centre of Excellence in AI for Education with an outlay of ₹500 crore, National Centres of Excellence for Skilling, broadband connectivity to schools and primary health centres, expansion of IIT capacity and the National Manufacturing Mission.
